name: kubernetes
description: Kubernetes integration — inspect and operate a cluster through the Kubernetes REST API using a ServiceAccount bearer token. List namespaces, pods, deployments, services and nodes, read pod logs, and scale deployments. Pure standard library with custom TLS (private CA) support.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Kubernetes cluster inspection and operations via the API server

fields.label: API Server URL
fields.helpText: Base URL of the Kubernetes API server.

fields.label: Service Account Token
fields.helpText: A ServiceAccount bearer token with permission to read/operate the target resources.

fields.label: CA Certificate (PEM)
fields.helpText: Cluster CA cert to verify TLS

tools.name: kubernetes.list_namespaces
tools.description: List all namespaces in the cluster.

tools.name: kubernetes.list_pods
tools.description: List pods in a namespace (or across all namespaces) with phase, node and restart count.

namespace.description: Namespace to list pods in; omit for all namespaces

tools.name: kubernetes.get_pod_logs
tools.description: Fetch the logs of a pod (optionally a specific container).

container.description: Container name (required only for multi-container pods)

tailLines.description: Return only the last N lines of the log

tools.name: kubernetes.list_deployments
tools.description: List deployments in a namespace (or across all namespaces) with desired and available replicas.

namespace.description: Namespace to list deployments in; omit for all namespaces

tools.name: kubernetes.list_services
tools.description: List services in a namespace (or across all namespaces).

namespace.description: Namespace to list services in; omit for all namespaces

tools.name: kubernetes.list_nodes
tools.description: List cluster nodes with their Ready status and kubelet version.

tools.name: kubernetes.scale_deployment
tools.description: Scale a deployment to a given number of replicas.
